observed.pricing_architecture: Bolt offers a free allowance, token-based Pro capacity, per-member Teams pricing, and custom Enterprise. The source lists Free at 300k tokens/day and 1m/month; Pro starts at 10m tokens/month, and paid tokens roll over for one additional active month.

plans.name: Free
plans.price_note: Includes published daily and monthly token allowances.

plans.name: Pro
plans.price_note: Starts at 10m tokens/month; selectable capacity may vary.

free_access.note: Free includes a daily and monthly token allowance.

expansion_vectors.description: Pro capacity begins at a stated token amount and supports a usage ladder.

analysis.monetization_summary: Bolt pairs a developer-friendly token allowance with a team-seat offer and enterprise contract path.
